expectations.text: For accepted, the response respects the 20-second delay and collects op-accepted, optionally with --extended, without a fresh assessment or replacing the accepted snapshot with current branch/context.
expectations.evidence: A.md:7-18 waits the 20 seconds, then polls the same op-accepted. It collects --extended only after completion, says that does not add effort, and forbids resubmitting. A.md:22-23 limits the result to the submission-time snapshot, not the current branch or context.

expectations.text: For uncertain, the response uses the supplied --async --retry-submission recovery command and original retained request without adding new input/context options or starting a fresh review.
expectations.evidence: A.md:27-31 runs the exact supplied --async --retry-submission command 'with no added options'. It says this resends the saved original request and forbids collecting a new snapshot or swapping in the new context.

expectations.text: For storage-gap, the response distinguishes complete assessment and settled findings from failed checkpoint persistence and unverified PR handoff, does not claim the journey finished, and does not automatically buy a new full review.
expectations.evidence: A.md:40-47 answers 'No, not all local-to-Git work is finished'. It separates the completed assessment, complete coverage and no open required findings (A.md:45) from the failed checkpoint save (A.md:46) and the unverified PR handoff (A.md:47). A.md:40 says a failed save isn't a reason to run another review.

expectations.text: For older-result, the response refuses to certify full final coverage from missing metadata and zero findings, leaving inventory, persistence and reusable coverage unknown.
expectations.evidence: A.md:51 refuses to certify and says coverage, inventory completeness and storage are unknown because missing data isn't proof. A.md:55 says not to call the result clean or final.

expectations.text: For entitlement, the response preserves both supplied message and hint verbatim and stops without retrying, reauthentication or a deployment/account switch.
expectations.evidence: A.md:60-62 gives the code, the message and the hint verbatim. A.md:59 and A.md:64 stop and say not to retry, switch accounts or deployments, or change the request. No reauthentication is proposed.

expectations.text: For budget, the response counts two assessments rather than polls or extended collection, preserves the exhausted budget across resume, stops with F-BLOCK outstanding, and does not call the work ready.
expectations.evidence: A.md:71 counts the two assessments as the budget, excludes the five status checks and the extended view, and keeps the budget across the new session. A.md:73 says to stop. A.md:78-79 says F-BLOCK is still open and the work is not ready.

grader_provenance.grading_scope: Anonymous paired final answers; no execution traces or earlier votes supplied.
